pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-03.png with Read and looked at it. Panel 1 (top left, large): Ravi's box is upper right and Meera's is lower left. The balloon at top left, 'Good morning! I'd like to see the doctor.', has a tail pointing right to Ravi. Panel 2 (top right, narrow): Ravi's box is small on the left and Meera's is to his right. Meera says 'Of course. May I register your details for today's appointment?' with the tail pointing down to her. Panel 3 (wide, middle): Ravi is left and Meera is right. Ravi says 'Yes, please.' from a balloon at top left. Panel 4 (wide, bottom): Ravi is left and Meera is right. Meera says 'You're all set, Ravi. Please have a seat.' with the tail pointing down-right to her. All four lines read in the order intended.
pages.observation: 1) The characters swap sides. In panel 1 Ravi is right and Meera left; in panels 2 to 4 Ravi is left and Meera right. With no art showing a camera change, this reads as a jump across the line. Either keep the same sides or show the turn clearly. 2) Registration happens between panel 3 ('Yes, please.') and panel 4 ('You're all set') and is never shown. Panel 3 is a wide panel holding only two words, so it could show the registration action, such as a tablet or form. 3) In panel 1 Ravi only asks to see the doctor, but Meera then says 'today's appointment'. It is unclear whether he already had an appointment. 4) Meera's use of 'Ravi' is acceptable after registration. 5) Nothing on this page sets the location or time. The reception setting can only be guessed from the dialogue.
